catastrophizing: It feels like this could knock everything over.
Hmm… my chest was beating so fast, but maybe we can breathe now.
Some of those terrifying outcomes might not actually arrive after all.
Even if the road gets bumpy, we aren't completely helpless.
The fear was huge, but morning always finds a way to arrive.
mind_reading: It feels like they're quietly judging you.
Well… I was whispering in the dark; I can't actually read their minds.
Maybe their quietness was just their own tiredness speaking.
People carry so many worries that have nothing to do with you.
I was letting anxiety make up stories. You are welcome here.
fortune_telling: It feels like tomorrow's ending is already written.
My crystal wings are cloudy; maybe I'm not seeing clearly at all.
The story hasn't unfolded yet; things might turn out much softer.
There are so many unseen ways this could turn into something gentle.
Let's put down the heavy prophecy and take today one step at a time.
all_or_nothing: It feels like if we can't be completely flawless, we've failed.
Hmm… guarding against every mistake has made us so very tired.
Maybe there's a big, beautiful world between zero and one hundred.
Being a learning, imperfect human is actually more than good enough.
We don't have to be perfect to be worthy of rest and love.
overgeneralization: It feels like this disappointment is going to repeat forever.
My echo was so loud that I forgot each day is brand new.
There were times when things went right, even if today felt bruised.
A single stumble is just one moment in time, not a lifetime rule.
This moment doesn't define tomorrow. We can begin again gently.
should_statements: It feels like you should already have everything figured out.
Oof… holding up all those rigid rules made my spirit so heavy.
Maybe those rules were written by fear, not by what's kind and fair.
It's okay to move at your own pace; there's no race to win here.
The rules can soften now. You're allowed to just be who you are today.
labeling: It feels like one bad moment says who you are.
Ouch… that sticker was so sharp and cold; it must have stung so much.
A single word could never describe the vast, complex heart you carry.
You are someone who tries, who feels, and who is still growing.
Let's peel off that cruel tag and throw it away. You are so much more.
emotional_reasoning: It feels so real that it seems like it must be true.
The fog in our chest was so thick that it hid all the landmarks.
Feelings are real heartbeats, but they aren't always true compasses.
As the panic breathes out, the solid ground beneath us hasn't moved.
I can honour my heavy feelings and still look at what's really here.
personalization: It feels like whenever anything goes wrong, it's all on you.
Holding up this mirror and catching every blame made my arms shake.
Maybe other people's storms existed long before you arrived.
You don't have to apologize for things you never had the power to steer.
It's safe to put down what was never yours to hold. Rest your shoulders.
mental_filter: It feels like only that single stinging wound matters in the world.
The mesh was so tight it blocked all the gentle light from reaching you.
Look through the gaps—there are quiet kindnesses that were always here.
One dark pebble doesn't mean the whole riverbed is made of stone.
Let's open up the mesh and let all the quiet warmth flood back in.

tamed.catastrophizing: The Doomwyrm curls up like a tired dragon, resting its head in quiet peace. It's okay to feel small sometimes; you can get through hard things.
tamed.mind_reading: The Whisperer fades to a soft, comforting hum. You don't have to carry the burden of second-guessing everyone; your presence is enough.
tamed.fortune_telling: The Oracle Moth gently folds its luminous wings and perches calmly. The future is an unwritten page, full of quiet hope.
tamed.all_or_nothing: The Splitter melts its sharp edges and merges into a smooth, peaceful whole. Room has opened up in the middle, and you can breathe freely.
tamed.overgeneralization: The Echo Slime softens into clear, calm water. One painful ripple does not make an endless ocean; today is its own quiet day.
tamed.should_statements: The Shouldgeist releases its heavy mantle and floats like a comforting wisp of warm light. You are allowed to be gentle with your own rhythm.
tamed.labeling: The Tagling lets its stickers drift softly away into the breeze. You are a living, breathing human being—infinitely greater than any label.
tamed.emotional_reasoning: The Fogling disperses into a soft, golden mist, revealing clear, calm skies. Your feelings are honoured, and a little more peace has found its way in.
tamed.personalization: The Mirror Imp gently turns its mirror toward the sunlight and rests quietly. Not every wave is yours to calm; you have carried enough.
tamed.mental_filter: The Shadow Sieve tilts toward the sky, letting warm sunshine pour completely through. The world around you is so much wider and kinder than the shadows.

breaks: Unpacking heavy thoughts takes so much quiet courage. Maybe take a sip of water, let your shoulders drop, and just breathe for a moment.
You've done some deep, honest inner work. How about resting your eyes and watching the clouds or the trees outside the window for a little while?
The world can wait for a few quiet minutes. Step away from your desk, stretch your arms, and feel your feet firmly on the ground.
Place a hand somewhere comforting, take a slow breath, and remind yourself: you are doing just fine, exactly as you are.
Mental reframing is real emotional effort. Give yourself credit for showing up for yourself today, and enjoy a peaceful, guilt-free break.
If there's someone you feel safe around, or a pet nearby, maybe share a warm smile or a gentle 'hello'. You are not alone.
